svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 52 mm lengths of 16 x 4 mm flat bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round both ends to an 8 mm radius (file to a scribed circle).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two holes on the centre line, 8 mm from each end (36 mm apart):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5.2 mm at the top (pivot), 6.5 mm at the bottom (rod end).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the two arms clamped together so the holes match.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the arm lies flat on the outside of the angle's upright leg;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 5 mm stainless pin goes through both, head inside the angle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nyloc nut outside the arm, snug so the arm still swings.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The rod end butts on the arm's inside face; one M6 x 12

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: button-head screw through the arm into the rod.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stowed, the arm hangs straight down; raised, the grip is

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 39 mm from the end face (room for fingers).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: hole centres 36 mm apart, within 0.5 mm.
